text:
jess: Kicking off RC creation for v2.13.0-candidate-20260321. Need signoffs, artifact pin, smoke + KV warm. Target promo window 18:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Build created: gcr.io/redwood/serving:v2.13.0-rc.1 (sha256:abcd1234ef56). Artifact pinned to candidate-bucket. CI: smoke queued.

nate: Ack. I'll run smoke tests and kv warm. ETA ~20m. Will report regressions if any.

deploy-bot: Smoke CI passed (smoke-suite/42). Canary checks: 2/2 healthy. E2E quick grep shows no stack traces.

simran: Quick question — db-migration flag is off, right? We should avoid any schema changes in this RC.

jess: Confirmed — FLAG_DB_MIGRATION=false for this run. No schema changes included.

alexa: I'm on-call for the 18:00 PT promo window. Abort criteria I'm watching: >5% error rate sustained for 5m, p95 latency >800ms for 10m, or any NPE/stack trace in generation-service logs. Will take sheriff if triggered.

nate: Promotion plan: canary in us-west-2 1% traffic for 15m, then 10% for 30m, then ramp to 100% if green. KV warm plan: preload prefixes and prime top-10k keys. CLI snippets below: 
```
# pin artifact to candidate
rctl pin artifact --image gcr.io/redwood/serving:v2.13.0-rc.1 --env prod
# promote from canary to prod (example)
rctl promote --from canary --to prod --traffic 10 --schedule immediate
```

simran: Also adding auto-fallback policy: if node GPU OOM or node-pool pressure >80%, route policy -> fallback to v2.12.7-quant (lower mem) automatically. Will create policy entry.

jess: @alexa please ack sheriff handoff. Once @nate posts green we'll request the promo and set quiet window. :thumbsup:

alexa: Acked. I'll post rollback command and contact list on green.

deploy-bot: Promo request created: /promo request 1766543210 by jess. Approvers: eng-release, oncall, product-eng. Request id: promo-1766543210.

nate: Smoke run finished — GREEN. No regressions on our eval set. Minor tokenization diffs (expected). Memory and latency within bounds. Ready for canary.

jess: Starting canary promotion in 10 minutes. Radio check: all teams standby. Rollback command if needed: 
```
rctl rollback --to-image gcr.io/redwood/serving:v2.12.7 --reason "high error during promo"
```

alexa: Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/telemetry/rcs/1766543210 — alert channels #prod-alerts and paging on-call.

simran: Watching reranker and embeddings drift. I'll post if we see >2% quality drop on golden prompts.

deploy-bot: Promotion to canary started (promo-1766543210). Applied traffic ramp: 1% -> 10% (schedule started).

jess: Leaving ops radio. Ping in this thread for quick escalation. If anyone needs the artifact SHA I can paste it. Thanks all. :rocket:
